<module id="alu">
    <description>ALU for a 32-bit MIPS-ISA CPU.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="a" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="b" width_description="[31:0]">A 32-bit input operand.</input>
        <input id="aluc" width_description="[5:0]">Control signal for selecting the operation to be performed.</input>
        <output id="r" width_description="[31:0]">Result of the operation.</output>
        <output id="zero">Indicates whether the result is zero.</output>
        <output id="carry">Indicates whether a carry occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="negative">Indicates whether the result is negative.</output>
        <output id="overflow">Indicates whether an overflow occurred during the operation.</output>
        <output id="flag">General flag, set based on specific operations (SLT and SLTU).</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="ADD">6'b100000</parameter>
        <parameter id="ADDU">6'b100001</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUB">6'b100010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SUBU">6'b100011</parameter>
        <parameter id="AND">6'b100100</parameter>
        <parameter id="OR">6'b100101</parameter>
        <parameter id="XOR">6'b100110</parameter>
        <parameter id="NOR">6'b100111</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLT">6'b101010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLTU">6'b101011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLL">6'b000000</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRL">6'b000010</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRA">6'b000011</parameter>
        <parameter id="SLLV">6'b000100</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRLV">6'b000110</parameter>
        <parameter id="SRAV">6'b000111</parameter>
        <parameter id="LUI">6'b001111</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <reg id="res" width_description="[31:0]">Register to store the result of the operation.</reg>
        <wire id="signed_a" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand a.</wire>
        <wire id="signed_b" width_description="[31:0]">Signed representation of input operand b.</wire>
        <assign id="signed_a" expression="a"/>
        <assign id="signed_b" expression="b"/>
        <always id="result_assignment" sensitivity_list="aluc or a or b">
            <case id="operation_selection" expression="aluc">
                <item id="add_operation" condition="'h0 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_a + signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="sub_operation" condition="'h1 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_a - signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="and_operation" condition="'h2 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_a & signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="or_operation" condition="'h3 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_a | signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="xor_operation" condition="'h4 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_a ^ signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="nor_operation" condition="'h5 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{~(signed_a | signed_b)}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="slt_operation" condition="'h6 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{{31{1'b0}}, signed_a < signed_b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="sltu_operation" condition="'h7 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{{31{1'b0}}, a < b}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="sll_operation" condition="'h8 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{b << a}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="srl_operation" condition="'h9 == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{b >> a}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="sra_operation" condition="'ha == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_b >>> a}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="sllv_operation" condition="'hb == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{b << a[4:0]}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="srav_operation" condition="'hc == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{b >> a[4:0]}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="srav_operation" condition="'hd == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{signed_b >>> a[4:0]}"/>
                </item>
                <item id="lui_operation" condition="'he == aluc">
                    <assign id="res" expression="{a[15:0], 16'h0000}"/>
                </item>
                <default>
                    <assign id="res" expression="32'hzzzzzzzz"/>
                </default>
            </case>
        </always>
        <assign id="r" expression="res[31:0]"/>
        <assign id="flag" expression="(aluc == 'h6 || aluc == 'h7)? res[0]: 1'bz"/>
        <assign id="zero" expression="&(~res)? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
        <assign id="carry" expression="1'bz"/>
        <assign id="negative" expression="res[31]? 1'b1 : 1'b0"/>
        <assign id="overflow" expression="1'bz"/>
    </logic_description>
</module>
